title: Page 114
transc:
Wash'n 3.10 P. M.
R OBrien Jamestown  May 8 1864
growl may paddle Katy for Knox your despatch torch postpone
has just reached me zebra we have as yet no
official wick from Jupiter unity nothing is known of his
condition except from new papers whites which represent plank days
hard ravishing on Thursday and Friday zebra from pledge to
platina promise wilkes are sent back & Ingalls wrangles yesterday
at noon to shelter Meigs that virgin it is said
the ridge are retiring violet zodiac in respect to the
reserves mentioned in your telegram there are none at the
disposal torch quadroon zebra John has with him all the
whisky and you will have to depend only up on 
such as may have been provided in your programme with
him unity your despatch will be forwarded to him to
apprise him of your condition and for his instructions zodiac
your success thus far is extremely gratifying to the bologna
and this quadroon and we hope your skill and good
luck may accomplish all your wishes youth Bruno awful hot
Thos. T. Eckert


Jamestown 3.30 AM May 9 . 1864 
Maj Eckert Di
I left Knox head quarters person miles from Bermuda
landing rosaile all quit and ready to move in
morning zodiac wests pacific roman pluming at Harris sons
landing to join us I will start line tomorrow
all working fine will endeavor to keep you posted
R OBrien
